concerns.text: Phase 5c (Tasks T055-T058) implements 'Cross-Cultural Stylometric Validation' which is NOT present in spec.md (FR-001 to FR-008, US-1 to US-4) or plan.md. The spec explicitly defines the scope, and this phase constitutes unapproved scope creep. No spec FR/SC maps to these tasks, and the plan does not authorize this work.

Task T007.1 mandates manual annotation of 20 stories. Spec SC-001 requires validation against a 'gold-standard subset of 50 stories'. The task output (20) is insufficient to satisfy the spec's success criterion (50), leaving SC-001 untestable as defined.

Task T009.6 generates 'local manual annotations' for reader responses. Spec US-4 and SC-006 require 'human participants (or a validated proxy simulation)' and reference 'verified external reader-response datasets'. The task lacks a mechanism to validate the 'local manual' data as a 'validated proxy' or link it to an external source, creating a gap in satisfying SC-006's validity measurement.

Task T002 includes 'textstat' and 'wordfreq' in requirements.txt. These dependencies are not listed in plan.md's 'Primary Dependencies' nor are they required by any FR in spec.md (FR-001 uses spaCy, FR-002 uses TF-IDF). They appear to be remnants of the removed Phase 5c, creating stale dependency tags.
